hooks.command:
python3 -c "
import json,re,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd=d.get('tool_input',{}).get('command','')
if re.search(r'(^|;|&&|\|)\s*git\s+(fetch|pull)\b.*\bupstream\b', cmd):
    if '--no-tags' not in cmd or not re.search(r'\bmain\b|refs/tags/', cmd):
        print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PreToolUse','permissionDecision':'deny','permissionDecisionReason':'git fetch/pull from the upstream remote must pass --no-tags and target either main or an explicit refs/tags/<tag> refspec (see .claude/rules/fork-cve-patching.md)'}}))
"
